versos.hebraico: מִ֭שְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־דָּוִ֑ד מֶ֝֗לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
controles.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
controles.livre: Provérbios de Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel.

versos.hebraico: לָדַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֣ה וּמוּסָ֑ר לְ֝הָבִ֗ין אִמְרֵ֥י בִינָֽה׃

controles.web: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
controles.kjv: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
controles.livre: Para conhecer a sabedoria e a instrução; para entender as palavras da prudência;

versos.hebraico: לָ֭קַחַת מוּסַ֣ר הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃

controles.web: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
controles.kjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
controles.livre: Para obter a instrução do entendimento; justiça, juízo e equidades;

versos.hebraico: לָתֵ֣ת לִפְתָאיִ֣ם עָרְמָ֑ה לְ֝נַ֗עַר דַּ֣עַת וּמְזִמָּֽה׃

controles.web: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man:
controles.kjv: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
controles.livre: Para dar inteligência aos simples, conhecimento e bom senso aos jovens.

versos.hebraico: יִשְׁמַ֣ע חָ֭כָם וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶ֑קַח וְ֝נָב֗וֹן תַּחְבֻּל֥וֹת יִקְנֶֽה׃

controles.web: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
controles.kjv: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
controles.livre: O sábio ouvirá, e crescerá em conhecimento; o bom entendedor obterá sábios conselhos.

versos.hebraico: לְהָבִ֣ין מָ֭שָׁל וּמְלִיצָ֑ה דִּבְרֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים וְחִידֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
controles.kjv: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
controles.livre: Para entender provérbios e sua interpretação; as palavras dos sábios, e seus enigmas.

versos.hebraico: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה רֵאשִׁ֣ית דָּ֑עַת חָכְמָ֥ה וּ֝מוּסָ֗ר אֱוִילִ֥ים בָּֽזוּ׃פ

controles.web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
controles.kjv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
controles.livre: O temor ao SENHOR é o principio do conhecimento; os tolos desprezam a sabedoria e a instrução.

versos.hebraico: שְׁמַ֣ע בְּ֭נִי מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑יךָ וְאַל־תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ תּוֹרַ֥ת אִמֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
controles.kjv: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
controles.livre: Filho meu, ouve a instrução de teu pai; e não abandones a doutrina de tua mãe.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י׀ לִוְיַ֤ת חֵ֓ן הֵ֬ם לְרֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַ֝עֲנָקִ֗ים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
controles.kjv: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
controles.livre: Porque serão um ornamento gracioso para tua cabeça; e colares para teu pescoço.

versos.hebraico: בְּנִ֡י אִם־יְפַתּ֥וּךָ חַ֝טָּאִ֗ים אַל־תֹּבֵֽא׃

controles.web: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
controles.kjv: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
controles.livre: Filho meu, se os pecadores tentarem te convencer, não te deixes influenciar.

versos.hebraico: אִם־יֹאמְרוּ֮ לְכָ֪ה אִ֫תָּ֥נוּ נֶאֶרְבָ֥ה לְדָ֑ם נִצְפְּנָ֖ה לְנָקִ֣י חִנָּֽם׃

controles.web: If they say, “Come with us, Let’s lay in wait for blood; let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause;
controles.kjv: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
controles.livre: Se disserem: Vem conosco, vamos espiar derramamento de sangue; preparemos uma emboscada ao inocente sem razão.

versos.hebraico: נִ֭בְלָעֵם כִּשְׁא֣וֹל חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים כְּי֣וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

controles.web: let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
controles.kjv: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
controles.livre: Vamos tragá-los vivos, como se fosse o mundo dos mortos; e inteiros, como os que descem à cova.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־ה֣וֹן יָקָ֣ר נִמְצָ֑א נְמַלֵּ֖א בָתֵּ֣ינוּ שָׁלָֽל׃

controles.web: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
controles.kjv: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
controles.livre: Acharemos toda espécie de coisas valiosas, encheremos nossas casas de despojos.

versos.hebraico: גּ֭וֹרָ֣לְךָ תַּפִּ֣יל בְּתוֹכֵ֑נוּ כִּ֥יס אֶ֝חָ֗ד יִהְיֶ֥ה לְכֻלָּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse.”
controles.kjv: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
controles.livre: Lança tua sorte entre nós, compartilharemos todos de uma só bolsa.

versos.hebraico: בְּנִ֗י אַל־תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ אִתָּ֑ם מְנַ֥ע רַ֝גְלְךָ֗ מִנְּתִיבָתָֽם׃

controles.web: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
controles.kjv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
controles.livre: Filho meu, não sigas teu caminho com eles; desvia teu pé para longe de onde eles passarem;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י רַ֭גְלֵיהֶם לָרַ֣ע יָר֑וּצוּ וִֽ֝ימַהֲר֗וּ לִשְׁפָּךְ־דָּֽם׃

controles.web: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
controles.kjv: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
controles.livre: Porque os pés deles correm para o mal, e se apressam para derramar sangue.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־חִ֭נָּם מְזֹרָ֣ה הָרָ֑שֶׁת בְּ֝עֵינֵ֗י כָל־בַּ֥עַל כָּנָֽף׃

controles.web: For in vain is the net spread in the sight of any bird:
controles.kjv: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
controles.livre: Certamente é inútil se estender a rede diante da vista de todas as aves;

versos.hebraico: וְ֭הֵם לְדָמָ֣ם יֶאֱרֹ֑בוּ יִ֝צְפְּנ֗וּ לְנַפְשֹׁתָֽם׃

controles.web: but these lay wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
controles.kjv: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
controles.livre: Porém estes estão esperando o derramamento de seu próprio sangue; e preparam emboscada para suas próprias almas.

versos.hebraico: כֵּ֗ן אָ֭רְחוֹת כָּל־בֹּ֣צֵֽעַ בָּ֑צַע אֶת־נֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלָ֣יו יִקָּֽח׃פ

controles.web: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
controles.kjv: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
controles.livre: Assim são os caminhos de todo aquele que tem ganância pelo lucro desonesto; ela tomará a alma daqueles que a tem.

versos.hebraico: חָ֭כְמוֹת בַּח֣וּץ תָּרֹ֑נָּה בָּ֝רְחֹב֗וֹת תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
controles.kjv: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
controles.livre: A sabedoria grita pelas ruas; nas praças ela levanta sua voz.

versos.hebraico: בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הֹמִיּ֗וֹת תִּ֫קְרָ֥א בְּפִתְחֵ֖י שְׁעָרִ֥ים בָּעִ֗יר אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ תֹאמֵֽר׃

controles.web: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
controles.kjv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
controles.livre: Ela clama nas encruzilhadas, onde passam muita gente; às entradas das portas, nas cidades ela diz suas mensagens:

versos.hebraico: עַד־מָתַ֣י׀ פְּתָיִם֮ תְּֽאֵהֲב֫וּ פֶ֥תִי וְלֵצִ֗ים לָ֭צוֹן חָמְד֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים יִשְׂנְאוּ־דָֽעַת׃

controles.web: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
controles.kjv: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
controles.livre: Até quando, ó tolos, amareis a tolice? E vós zombadores, desejareis a zombaria? E vós loucos, odiareis o conhecimento?

versos.hebraico: תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ לְֽת֫וֹכַחְתִּ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה אַבִּ֣יעָה לָכֶ֣ם רוּחִ֑י אוֹדִ֖יעָה דְבָרַ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
controles.kjv: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
controles.livre: Convertei-vos à minha repreensão; eis que vos derramarei meu espírito, e vos farei saber minhas palavras.

versos.hebraico: יַ֣עַן קָ֭רָאתִי וַתְּמָאֵ֑נוּ נָטִ֥יתִי יָ֝דִ֗י וְאֵ֣ין מַקְשִֽׁיב׃

controles.web: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
controles.kjv: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
controles.livre: Mas porque eu clamei, e recusastes; estendi minha mão, e não houve quem desse atenção,

versos.hebraico: וַתִּפְרְע֥וּ כָל־עֲצָתִ֑י וְ֝תוֹכַחְתִּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲבִיתֶֽם׃

controles.web: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
controles.kjv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
controles.livre: E rejeitastes todo o meu conselho, e não quisestes minha repreensão,

versos.hebraico: גַּם־אֲ֭נִי בְּאֵידְכֶ֣ם אֶשְׂחָ֑ק אֶ֝לְעַ֗ג בְּבֹ֣א פַחְדְּכֶֽם׃

controles.web: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you;
controles.kjv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
controles.livre: Também eu rirei em vosso sofrimento, e zombarei, quando vier vosso medo.

versos.hebraico: בְּבֹ֤א כשאוה׀ פַּחְדְּכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭אֵידְכֶם כְּסוּפָ֣ה יֶאֱתֶ֑ה בְּבֹ֥א עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם צָרָ֥ה וְצוּקָֽה׃

controles.web: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind; when distress and anguish come on you.
controles.kjv: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
controles.livre: Quando vier vosso temor como tempestade, e a causa de vosso sofrimento como ventania, quando vier sobre vós a opressão e a angústia,

versos.hebraico: אָ֣ז יִ֭קְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה יְ֝שַׁחֲרֻ֗נְנִי וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃

controles.web: Then will they call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;
controles.kjv: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
controles.livre: Então clamarão a mim; porém eu não responderei; de madrugada me buscarão, porém não me acharão.

versos.hebraico: תַּ֭חַת כִּי־שָׂ֣נְאוּ דָ֑עַת וְיִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לֹ֣א בָחָֽרוּ׃

controles.web: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
controles.kjv: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord:
controles.livre: Porque odiaram o conhecimento; e escolheram não temer ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־אָב֥וּ לַעֲצָתִ֑י נָ֝אֲצ֗וּ כָּל־תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃

controles.web: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
controles.kjv: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
controles.livre: Não concordaram com meu conselho, e desprezaram toda a minha repreensão.

versos.hebraico: וְֽ֭יֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִ֣י דַרְכָּ֑ם וּֽמִמֹּעֲצֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃

controles.web: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
controles.kjv: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
controles.livre: Por isso comerão do fruto do seu próprio caminho, e se fartarão de seus próprios conselhos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י מְשׁוּבַ֣ת פְּתָיִ֣ם תַּֽהַרְגֵ֑ם וְשַׁלְוַ֖ת כְּסִילִ֣ים תְּאַבְּדֵֽם׃

controles.web: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
controles.kjv: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
controles.livre: Pois o desvio dos tolos os matará, e a confiança dos loucos os destruirá.

versos.hebraico: וְשֹׁמֵ֣עַֽ לִ֭י יִשְׁכָּן־בֶּ֑טַח וְ֝שַׁאֲנַ֗ן מִפַּ֥חַד רָעָֽה׃פ

controles.web: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
controles.kjv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
controles.livre: Porém aquele que me ouvir habitará em segurança, e estará tranquilo do temor do mal.
